question: Does the Free plan include SAML single sign-on?

answer.answer: No. SAML 2.0 single sign‑on is only available on the Business plan; the Free plan does not include SAML SSO.

citations.quote: SAML 2.0 single sign-on is available on the Business plan only.

question: I'm on a monthly plan and cancel after 10 days. Do I get any money back?

answer.answer: No. For monthly plans, CloudSync does not provide partial‑month refunds. You can cancel at any time, but you will retain access until the end of the paid month and will not receive a refund for the unused days.

citations.quote: Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time. Monthly plans do not receive partial-month refunds; access continues until the end of the paid month.

question: What is the total cost of 3 Business users billed annually for 2 years?

answer.answer: The Business plan costs $17 per user per month when billed annually. For 3 users over 2 years (24 months), the total cost is 3 × $17 × 24 = $1,224.

citations.quote: Business: … Price is $20 per user per month when billed monthly, or $17 per user per month when billed annually.

question: The customer in ticket T-1005 bought an annual plan 12 days ago. Are they eligible for a full refund?

answer.answer: Yes. Since the annual plan was purchased only 12 days ago, it falls within the 30‑day window for a full refund on annual plans.

citations.quote: Annual plans receive a full refund if you cancel within 30 days of purchase.

question: Does CloudSync offer a student discount?

answer.answer: Based on the current CloudSync documentation, there is no mention of a special student discount. The available plans (Free, Pro, Business) and their pricing are listed without any education‑specific pricing or discounts.

citations.quote: CloudSync has three plans... Free, Pro, Business. Price is $12 per user per month when billed monthly, or $10 per user per month when billed annually.

question: Do I need to do anything if I see error E-5001?

answer.answer: You don’t need to take any immediate steps. Error **E‑5001** means the CloudSync servers couldn’t be reached. The client will automatically retry with back‑off, so you can simply wait and, if you like, check the status page. Only if the error persists for more than about 30 minutes should you investigate further or contact support.

citations.quote: E-5001: Server unavailable ... Check the status page. The app retries automatically with increasing delays, so no action is needed unless the error lasts more than 30 minutes.

question: What happens to my files while my account is read-only after a failed payment?

answer.answer: When a payment fails and your account is switched to read‑only (after the 14‑day grace period), all of your files remain safe and you can still download them. However, you won’t be able to upload new files, edit existing ones, or make any changes until you update your payment method and restore full access.

citations.quote: Files stay safe and downloadable while the account is read-only.
